finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit 0, 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump:

- [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Was throwing on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) treated an unset `backoffEnabled` as invalid instead of `false`. New config loader leaves it `undefined` when off.

The rest was deprecation noise (`Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, `punycode`, etc), left as is.

Next: nothing.
